name: Collage Section
summary: Passive finite ordered media collection with native list and figure semantics, persistent captions, one item-level feature span, and target-owned activation.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Heading-labelled native section or untitled generic root, rendered only for a valid item collection.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional heading region omitted with empty heading content.

anatomy.name: heading
anatomy.description: Visible contextual heading that names the native section.

anatomy.name: grid
anatomy.description: Native unordered list preserving target-authored item order.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Native list item containing one valid media figure.

anatomy.name: featureItem
anatomy.description: Item-level visual span modifier that does not change source order or semantics.

anatomy.name: link
anatomy.description: Target-owned native destination wrapping one figure only when a real URL exists.

anatomy.name: figure
anatomy.description: Native figure relating one target-owned media node and optional caption.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Target-owned informative or intentionally decorative media with explicit alternative-text intent.

anatomy.name: caption
anatomy.description: Optional persistent native figcaption available without hover or focus.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Single semantic size; track and row geometry remain private and container-responsive.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive visible collection; feature is item metadata rather than component state.

states.name: linkedItemFocus
states.description: Visible focus belongs only to target-owned native destinations or controls.

behavior.name: passiveMediaAndActivationBoundary
behavior.description: The neutral base owns one finite native media collection, source order, persistent captions and feature geometry. Targets own real destinations, Lightbox or commerce controls, media delivery and analytics; passive items never enter the tab order.

behavior.name: strictRequiredItems
behavior.description: The complete root is omitted when no valid target-owned item remains.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: Optional trimmed visible heading; when present, its target-unique id names the native section.

properties.name: items
properties.description: One or more ordered valid native list-item/figure compositions; target records own media, caption, feature metadata and any real destination.

accessibility: Use native ul/li and figure/figcaption semantics with useful target-authored alternatives for informative media.
Preserve authored DOM order; feature spans never reorder speech, focus or collapsed presentation.
Captions remain visible without hover, focus, touch or motion.
Passive items receive no tabindex, role or click handler; target-owned interactive content uses native links or controls with visible focus and descriptive names.
Omit the complete component when no valid required item remains and avoid an unnamed section landmark when the optional heading is absent.

web.notes: Implemented with native semantic markup and components/css/sections.css.

shopify.notes: Target-native localized image-block section with strict omission and zero JavaScript.
